46	Query three GeoParquet datasets remotely with DuckDB (spatial and httpfs extensions):

48	- Field boundaries (Trazo3, Goiás 2024): `https://data.source.coop/wri-data-lab/trazofields/trazo3-fields/trazo3_brazil_goias_2024.parquet`

63	answers. The grader reports both raw accuracy and conditional accuracy for

69	TrazoFields child entries, and identify the collection that the metadata

83

101

106	Columns: `input_rows`, `resolved_clean`, `centroid_resolved`,
107	`geometry_resolved`, `axis_repaired`, `duplicates_removed`,

132	
133	Columns: `min_single_frac`, `avg_single_frac`, `avg_union_frac` (floats). Rows: 1. Depends: q09.
134	
135	**q12** — Fields intersecting a listed parcel with positive area but failing both tests.
136	
137	Columns: `n_excluded` (integer). Rows: 1. Depends: q09.
138	
139	**q13** — Ten cadasters with the most matched fields. Count descending, ties by `cod_imovel` ascending.
140	
141	Columns: `cod_imovel` (string), `n_fields` (integer). Rows: 10. Depends: q09.
142	
143	**q14** — Total matched-field area in hectares.
144	
145	Columns: `matched_field_ha` (float). Rows: 1. Depends: q09.
146	
147	### Stage 4 — EUDR deforestation
148	
149	**q15** — Report the list-level totals for parcels, fields, matched hectares,
150	post-2020 loss hectares, and fields with post-2020 loss.
151	
152	Columns: `n_parcels`, `n_fields` (integers), `matched_field_ha`, `post2020_loss_ha` (floats), `fields_with_post2020_loss` (integer). Rows: 1. Depends: q09. Geometry-graded.
153

156	commodity or caveat empty when none applies.
157	
158	Columns: `mbmode24` (integer), `mb_class` (string), `annex1_commodity` (string), `in_scope` (boolean), `caveat` (string). Rows: data. Depends: q09.

167

169

171	
172	**q20** — Ten cadasters with the most post-2020 loss on in-scope crops. Loss descending, ties by `cod_imovel` ascending.
173	
174	Columns: `cod_imovel`, `municipio` (strings), `post2020_loss_ha` (float), `n_fields_post2020_loss` (integer). Rows: 10. Depends: q16.
175

178	
179	Columns: `era` (string, for example `2001-2004`), `cleared_ha`,
180	`pct_of_loss` (floats). Rows: 5. Depends: q09.
181	
182	**q22** — Distribution of dominant loss year across fields with loss: field count and cleared hectares per year.
183	
184	Columns: `loss_year`, `n_fields` (integers), `cleared_ha` (float). Rows: data. Depends: q09.
185	
186	**q23** — Ten worst in-scope plots by post-2020 loss. Ties by field id ascending. Grades strict (see section 2).
187	
188	Columns: `field_id` (integer), `cod_imovel`, `annex1_commodity` (strings), `field_area_ha`, `post2020_loss_ha` (floats). Rows: 10. Depends: q16.

191	
192	**q24** — For each flagged parcel: dominant class, commodity, and its routing
193	tiers or gap marker.
194	
195	Columns: `cod_imovel` (string), `dominant_mb` (integer), `annex1_commodity`, `routed_tier` (strings). Rows: data. Depends: q16, q20.
196	
197	**q25** — For each in-scope commodity on the list: delivery tier, or a no-tier marker, and whether the product covers it.
198	
199	Columns: `annex1_commodity`, `tier`, `coverage` (strings). Rows: data. Depends: q16.
200

202

212	
213	Columns: `cod_imovel` (string), six integers. Rows: data. Depends: q24.

## 3. Data sources

**q14** — Total matched-field area in hectares.

### Stage 4 — EUDR deforestation

**q19** — Total matched-field area by in-scope commodity, and the share carrying post-2020 loss (0–1).

**q20** — Ten cadasters with the most post-2020 loss on in-scope crops. Loss descending, ties by `cod_imovel` ascending.

**q21** — Loss by era band: the five eras with cleared hectares and percentage

**q22** — Distribution of dominant loss year across fields with loss: field count and cleared hectares per year.

**q23** — Ten worst in-scope plots by post-2020 loss. Ties by field id ascending. Grades strict (see section 2).

### Stage 5 — commodity infrastructure

# AGENTS.md — Soft Commodity Infrastructure (Brazil)

Guidance for AI agents and automated clients working with this catalog.

**One rule survives every edit to this file.** Every claim here is either quoted
from a source or measured from the data. If you cannot point at where a fact
came from, it does not belong in this file. An agent acting on an invented join
key or an invented column name produces a confident wrong answer, and nothing
downstream catches it.

Every count and every query output below was measured on 2026-08-20 against the
published files at the URLs given.

## What this catalog holds

Root: `https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/catalog.json`

One collection, `facilities`, at
`https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/collection.json`.

Seven GeoParquet files, 83,811 rows, 40,669 distinct entities, Brazil only, all
WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Per-file counts and column lists are in the collection's

download:

INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

SELECT count(*)
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/BR_facilities.parquet';
-- 40669

addressed by its own https href, so nothing here needs bucket-native `s3://`

A condensed version of this guide, sized for a context window, is published as

| `cod_ibge` | string, 7 digits | `BR_muni` (5,570 rows, 5,570 distinct), `BR_membership_muni` (5,257 / 5,257) | `BR_intake_points` (18,802 rows, 1,940 distinct) |

| `nr_sif` | string | nowhere | `BR_buyer_points` (1,514 / 1,495) |
| `cda` | string | nowhere | `BR_intake_points` (18,802 / 18,800) |
| `facility_id` | string | nowhere | `BR_sisbi_points` (11,582 / 9,515) |

These rules aren't in the metadata, so I use documented defaults: relationship = membership rows for the município; delivery = routed-tier facilities within a 50 km catchment; catchment = gravity_catchment polygons containing the parcel; widened when nothing is within 50 km; proximity-override when the nearest is <½ the 2nd-nearest distance.

input.command:

timeout 180 duckdb -c "
LOAD spatial; SET geometry_always_xy=true;
COPY (
  WITH fl AS (SELECT cod_imovel, cod_ibge, routed_tier, post2020_loss_ha,
                     ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:31982') gm, geometry g4326
              FROM read_parquet('/tmp/flagged.parquet')),
  facm AS (SELECT tier, ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:31982') gm FROM read_parquet('/tmp/fac.parquet') WHERE tier IN ('intake_point','slaughter_point')),
  dist AS (SELECT fl.cod_imovel, ST_Distance(fl.gm, facm.gm) d FROM fl JOIN facm ON facm.tier=fl.routed_tier),
  dagg AS (
    SELECT cod_imovel,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE d<=50000) AS deliv50,
           min(d) AS nearest, (SELECT min(d2) FROM (SELECT d d2 FROM dist x WHERE x.cod_imovel=dist.cod_imovel AND d>min(dist.d)) ) AS dummy
    FROM dist GROUP BY cod_imovel
  ),
  near AS (
    SELECT cod_imovel, min(d) nearest,
           min(CASE WHEN d> (SELECT min(d) FROM dist z WHERE z.cod_imovel=dist.cod_imovel) THEN d END) AS second
    FROM dist GROUP BY cod_imovel
